subject.title: Containerized/self-hosted deploys can't use externalized channel plugins: openKeyedStore is gated to trusted plugins, with no supported way to trust a self-hosted channel

question: Should OpenClaw add a provenance-preserving immutable/container plugin root for trusted official external channels, and where should the trusted install record live when the runtime state dir is mounted?
rationale: The source reproduction is clear, but granting keyed-store access changes the plugin trust boundary and the durable state/install-record contract for container deployments.

options.title: Design immutable official plugin root
options.body: Add an installer/runtime path that preserves official package identity and install provenance outside the mounted mutable state dir, then document and test the container workflow.

options.title: Document current unsupported shape
options.body: Keep the fail-closed model unchanged and document that trusted official external channels require the runtime to see the same state dir used by `openclaw plugins install`.

options.title: Only land narrow ClawHub trust fixes
options.body: Let narrower reports such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92452 handle npm-only ClawHub provenance while leaving immutable-container support undecided.

recommendation.title: Design immutable official plugin root
recommendation.body: Add an installer/runtime path that preserves official package identity and install provenance outside the mounted mutable state dir, then document and test the container workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned reviewer and already framed the trust-model decision on the issue.
